title: MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00367v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. translated_title: MoRA：基于路由器偏置学习与专家逼近的MoE剪枝
translated_abstract: 摘要：混合专家模型通过为每个词元仅激活一小部分专家，实现了在有限每词元计算量下的参数扩展，但部署此类模型仍需要将完整的专家池加载到内存中。结构化专家剪枝可以通过移除专家来有效降低内存占用。然而，现有的剪枝方法要么采用与模型性能不够契合的专家排序准则，要么依赖计算代价高昂的有效专家子集搜索。此外，这些方法通常忽视了所保留专家之间的路由行为冗余。在本文中，我们提出了基于路由器偏置学习与专家逼近的MoE剪枝方法，这是一个用于结构化MoE专家剪枝的框架。我们为每个专家引入一个可学习的路由器偏置，并通过最小化语言建模损失和路由多样性正则项来优化这些偏置。学习到的路由器偏置 shar（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MoRA提出了一种结构化MoE专家剪枝框架，通过为每个专家引入可学习的路由器偏置（结合语言建模损失与路由多样性正则化进行优化）并进行专家逼近，在降低内存占用的同时缓解了现有剪枝方法与模型性能不契合、搜索代价高以及保留专家间路由行为冗余的问题。
en_tdlr: MoRA proposes a structured MoE expert pruning framework that introduces learnable router biases for each expert—optimized by minimizing language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer—along with expert approximation, effectively reducing memory usage while addressing misaligned ranking criteria, costly subset searching, and routing-behavior redundancy among retained experts.
